text: BBC reports the Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) issued a red alert over ecstasy tablets shaped like former US President Donald Trump, citing public safety concerns.

Ecstasy (MDMA) can raise heart rate, cause dehydration, anxiety, and rare severe hyperthermia; unknown‑shaped tablets may hide impurities, increasing risk. If you encounter such pills, seek professional medical help—not self‑treat.
